# Flink

> Flink (myflink.in) is a free link-in-bio page for creators and professionals, built for India. Each user gets one short link, myflink.in/yourname, that holds their social profiles, website and contact details.

## What Flink does

- One link for Instagram, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Facebook, Threads, Snapchat, Telegram, Discord, Twitch, Spotify, GitHub, Reddit, Medium, email, phone and custom links
- Save contact: visitors download a vCard with the person's name, phone, email and website in one tap
- QR code for every profile, for print and in-person sharing
- Private profiles: hidden from visitors and search engines
- Free to create; sign up with email or Google

- [Sitemap of public profiles](https://myflink.in/sitemap.xml)

## Profile pages

Public profiles live at https://myflink.in/{handle} and include the person's name, bio, location and links, with ProfilePage/Person structured data.
